subject: Invoice milestone SLAs, reconciliation cadence, and drawdown kpi handback
messages:
From: Marta Silva <marta@aurora-analytics.com>
To: David Kim <david.kim@redwood.com>
Cc: Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.com>, Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 20 Oct 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Invoice milestone schedule + VAT evidence for Q4 prepay

Hi David —

Thanks again for the walkthrough yesterday. Per our procurement team, we need a clear milestone invoicing schedule tied to the committed spend for the annual prepay so our AP team can align payment windows and VAT acceptance. High level asks from Aurora: 

- Single PDF invoice per milestone (we prefer monthly tranches)
- VAT evidence attached for AU entity (we need certificate and tax residency)
- Drawdown windows tied to usage thresholds + the SLA for invoice acceptance (48h)
- A short reconciliation cadence (monthly two-way recon + exception log)

Can you share a draft schedule and the fields your invoices will include (PO, remit, bank details) so I can route to our AP? We want to avoid delayed wire processing (our finance cutoffs are 15th and 30th of the month).

Attaching the Aurora billing contact card and our AP remit template (sent separately).

Thanks —
Marta Silva
Head of Finance Operations
Aurora Analytics
Attachments: none (AP template to follow)
From: David Kim <david.kim@redwood.com>
To: Marta Silva <marta@aurora-analytics.com>
Cc: Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.com>, Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 20 Oct 2026 11:05:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Invoice milestone schedule + VAT evidence for Q4 prepay

Marta —

Appreciate the clarity. Draft attached: Draft-Invoice-Schedule.xlsx. Short answers up front:

- We can do monthly invoice tranches aligned to committed spend milestones (1/12 by default) or custom tranche sizes — see the Draft.
- Each invoice will include: Redwood PO ref, Invoice #, Deal ID (DL-2026-1178), Remit instructions, Bank details, VAT line-by-line, and a one-page reconciliation summary.
- SLA: we propose a 48-hour technical acceptance window for invoice receipt (format/bank details) and 7 business days for substantive disputes.
- Drawdown windows: we will mark a drawdown event once usage exceeds the tranche threshold; payment is requested within your standard wire cutoffs.

Next steps for us (can Kimberly / Jonas help):
1) Kimberly — confirm the remit/bank details we should put on the invoice for Redwood US entity and attach AU VAT cert when available.
2) Jonas — we'll add the ledger tag + GL code for Aurora; can you prepare the two-way reconciliation sheet sample?
3) Marta — once you confirm, we'll send DocuSign for invoice acceptance and provide the initial signed invoice statement.

Thanks —
David Kim
Head, Customer Finance
Redwood Inference
Attachments: Draft-Invoice-Schedule.xlsx
From: Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.com>
To: David Kim <david.kim@redwood.com>, Marta Silva <marta@aurora-analytics.com>
Cc: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 21 Oct 2026 08:43:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Invoice milestone schedule + VAT evidence for Q4 prepay

Hi all —

I reviewed the draft and propose the following concrete deliverables: 

- Invoice remit (Redwood US): Redwood Inference, Inc.
  Bank: First Republic Bank
  Account #: 123456789
  Swift: FRBCUS6L
  PO field must include: Aurora PO # + DL-2026-1178

- VAT evidence: attaching AU-VAT-Cert.pdf (Redwood AU VAT registration). Marta, please confirm if Aurora needs our local tax agent attestation — happy to provide.

- Reconciliation cadence: monthly CSV export from our billing system on day 3 of the month, Aurora to return a reconciled file within 5 business days; exceptions submitted into shared spreadsheet (Drive link).

I've attached the AU VAT cert and updated the draft with bank details. Once David confirms the SLA language I'll seed the DocuSign packet.

Cheers,
Kimberly Park
Billing Operations Lead
Redwood Inference
Attachments: AU-VAT-Cert.pdf
From: Marta Silva <marta@aurora-analytics.com>

Cc: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.com>, Aurora Finance <finance@aurora-analytics.com>
Date: Thu, 22 Oct 2026 09:58:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Invoice milestone schedule + VAT evidence for Q4 prepay

Thanks, Kimberly — this looks good. Two quick clarifications from Aurora AP: 

1) Can Redwood include an invoice-level field for our tax ID (we'll populate on our side but need the slot)?
2) For the reconciliation CSV, can you add a column for 'drawdown-trigger-usage' (we need a simple metric to reconcile actual consumption vs tranche)?

We are OK with the proposed deadlines (day 3 export / 5 business day return). Please send the DocuSign and we'll have procurement sign the invoice acceptance by next Monday — our cutoffs mean seed payment will start on the 30th if everything is in the system.

DocuSign link: https://www.docusign.com/recipient/view?envelopeId=ABCDEF-2026-10

Regards,
Marta Silva
Head of Finance Operations
Aurora Analytics
From: David Kim <david.kim@redwood.com>

Date: Thu, 22 Oct 2026 15:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Invoice milestone schedule + VAT evidence for Q4 prepay

All —

Thanks — we will: 
- Add an 'Aurora Tax ID' field to the invoice template and the reconciliation CSV (Jonas will add 'drawdown-trigger-usage' column).
- Kimberly will send the DocuSign packet by EOD and include the signed invoice statement PDF after Aurora signs.
- I'll monitor acceptance and flag any exceptions to Aurora's AP to avoid the 30th cutoff slip.

Jonas / Kimberly — ping me if you need anything to finalize the packet. Marta — once signed we will schedule the first drawdown editorial check and provide a 1-page kpi handback (monthly).

-David
